en.answer:
The effect of <<11257>> is applied after it is Special Summoned.

Therefore, you can perform a Special Summon this turn, without counting the Special Summon of <<11257>> itself.
en.question: If you Special Summoned <<11257>>, are you unable to Special Summon that turn due to its effect that prevents both players from Special Summoning more than once per turn?
en.title: If you Special Summoned <<11257>>, are you unable to Special Summon that turn due to its effect that prevents both players from Special Summoning more than once per turn?

ja.answer:
「<<11257>>」の『②：このカードがモンスターゾーンに存在する限り、その間はお互いに１ターンに１度しかモンスターを特殊召喚できない』効果は、「<<11257>>」が特殊召喚された以降に適用される効果です。

したがって、「<<11257>>」自身の特殊召喚は含まず、このターンに１度、自分は特殊召喚を行う事ができます。
